$comment: T3 / FC3 / FC4: the ffmpeg sidecar is an LGPL build pinned by version and SHA256 per target. Change a pin only together with its hash.

source.note: Every target builds LGPL from this tarball: macOS with scripts/ffmpeg/build-macos.sh (no LGPL macOS prebuilt exists), Windows with scripts/ffmpeg/build-windows.sh under MSYS2 (BtbN's LGPL prebuilt is ~128 MB per binary).
